chunks: It is God who created you, then gave you sustenance, then He will make you die, and bring you back to life. Is there one among those you associate with Him who can do the least of these things? Too high and exalted is He for what they associate with Him!

key_terms.يُحْيِيكُمْ: He will bring you back to life

ai.seo_question: What are the four divine actions mentioned in Surah Ar-Rum that prove Allah's uniqueness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm Allah's absolute sovereignty over the cycle of existence, contrasting His singular power with the impotence of idols. The rhetorical challenge underscores the logical inconsistency of polytheism, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid by demonstrating that only the Creator can sustain and resurrect His creation.
